content: GitHub-style heatmap: store completion dates as array or query logs by date range, not boolean arrays indexed by offset. Generate grid by iterating N days backward from today, map each cell to YYYY-MM-DD, check Set membership of completions. 53-week grid = 371 cells arranged in 7 rows (days of week) x ~53 columns (weeks). CSS Grid or SVG both work; CSS Grid with fixed cell size is simpler. Component receives habitId, fetches logs in range, builds date Set, renders cells with active/inactive state. Click toggles completion for that date via repository.
